description: This file is a PHP source script for managing the web UI of Managed Services configuration in a device/router settings page. It includes PHP logic, HTML markup, embedded JavaScript, and server interactions for enabling/disabling services, managing trusted devices, and displaying configured services.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Initializes page mode with title and navigation identifier.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters or device configuration values.

methods.name: getParaValues
methods.description: Fetches parameter values for specified device objects and maps.

methods.name: resolve_IPV6_global_address
methods.description: Resolves and formats IPv6 global addresses based on input addresses.

methods.name: jAlert
methods.description: Displays an alert dialog with a message.

methods.name: jConfirm
methods.description: Displays a confirmation dialog with a message.

calls: jConfirm("Are you sure you want to delete this service?", "Are You Sure?", ...)
